summary: Record durable migrations and branch seed
Add durable database migrations and standard branch seed
details: Add Admin -> Migrations for national administrators. The page previews each additive migration, shows the last recorded run and any error, and applies Standard branches or Branch participation individually or in order. Every run is recorded in data_migrations with run count, timestamps, actor and result. Standard branches is an idempotent seed for Fusion National, VIC, NSW, QLD, WA, SA, TAS, ACT and NT with National as parent; existing branches are never renamed, re-parented or un-recognised. Branch participation remains blocked until the National branch exists. The command-line seed now uses the same service, and the participation migration remains available for deployment automation.

summary: Record branch participation and verification
Separate branch following from verified membership
details: Members choose the branches they follow during onboarding and in My Engage. Authorised administrators verify followers as members in a focused Branch governance workspace. Branch subscriptions are now Engage-owned preferences, while verified organisational membership stays in branch_memberships with source, verification and audit metadata. National governance is included for every verified account and never removed by branch preferences. Existing members without branch connections receive national scope silently and a one-time state branch invitation. Eligibility is decided in one service used by proposal pages, ballot submission, pending-vote promotion and digests. Followers can discover branch activity but cannot vote. Revocation requires a reason and preserves historical votes and the person's following preference. The migration backfills legacy membership metadata, adds subscriptions without duplicating them, assigns open proposals without branch context to national governance, and leaves branch-owned and archived records untouched. The Underground CRM boundary is implemented through applyExternalMembership: external membership facts can update organisational membership but never branch subscriptions, and local administrators cannot silently override CRM-sourced records. Tests cover national defaults, follow/unfollow idempotency, source integrity, permissions, migration, parent/child eligibility and new proposal defaults.

summary: Integrate Privacy Policy, Terms of Use and acceptance controls
details: Add owner-authorised legal documents at /privacy/ and /terms/ with the confirmed operator, ABN, registered party name, contact and correspondence address. The documents are explicit about identifiable ballots, national administrator access, small-ballot re-identification risk, retention limits, third-party processors and administrative ballot controls, and remain noindex while publication is pending. Add a server-side acceptance record, API and member gate, and enforce the gate on vote, comment, endorsement, proposal and amendment writes. Activation is interlocked: the gate remains inactive until both documents are published with real effective dates and LEGAL_ACCEPTANCE_ENABLED is set.
